interval.description: Time interval between data points Accepted values: '1min', '5min', '15min', '30min', '60min' only.

month.description: Specific month in 'YYYY-MM' format for historical intraday data; only for intraday intervals Very old dates may return no data; intraday history coverage is limited.

outputsize.description: Return latest 100 points ('compact') or full-length data ('full') Free-tier keys may return an 'Information' block instead of data when 'full' is requested.

symbol.description: The stock ticker symbol. For US stocks, use the ticker only (e.g., 'IBM', 'MSFT', 'AAPL'). For international stocks, append the exchange suffix: '.LON' for London Stock Exchange (e.g., 'TSCO.LON'), '.TRT' for Toronto Stock Exchange (e.g., 'SHOP.TRT'), '.DEX' for XETRA Germany (e.g., 'MBG.DEX'), '.BSE' for Bombay Stock Exchange (e.g., 'RELIANCE.BSE'), '.SHH' for Shanghai Stock Exchange (e.g., '600104.SHH'), '.SHZ' for Shenzhen Stock Exchange (e.g., '000002.SHZ'). Do not pass URLs - just the ticker symbol itself.
